hints.title: Transitive Swapping via Common Factors
hints.text: Elements sharing a common divisor greater than 1 can be swapped arbitrarily, making reachability transitive.

hints.title: Disjoint Set Connected Components
hints.text: Connect each number to its prime factors using union-find. All numbers in the same connected component can be rearranged in any sorted order.

hints.title: Component Membership Comparison
hints.text: Sort nums to obtain the target array. For every index i, check if nums[i] and sorted_nums[i] belong to the same component.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N * sqrt(M) * alpha(M) + N log N)
complexity.notes: Prime factor decomposition and disjoint set union checks.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing pairwise GCDs takes O(N^2) which times out for N = 3 * 10^4.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Connecting numbers directly to their prime factors reduces union operations to O(N * sqrt(M)).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that transitivity maps to connected components via prime factor unions.
